Game Overview

In Grab Piglet, the core idea is straightforward: catch the mischievous piglets in this whimsical match-3 adventure. Strategically clear the screen by aligning identical toys to make them vanish. With increasing toy drops and speed, your skills will be put to the test. Join the fun and save those playful piglets!
